== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the A New Hope [[DS-61-4]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/DS-61-4 (A New Hope)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity.

Membership is every verified existing article in this A New Hope family. Same name + same picture + same card type (#583). Virtual headings follow each article's |set=. [[DS-61-4 (PC Errata 2018 E card)]], [[DS-61-4 (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]], and [[DS-61-4 (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]] redirect to [[DS-61-4 (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (same-words remasters of Glossary 2.0). Do not invent printings.
</noinclude>
